title: PRE-ENT final matrix blocker OD-HIST04-A still reports EVOL-X formal B6 as PENDING_AUTHORITY although the roadmap closed it
affected_invariant: roadmap-as-closure-SSOT (authority hierarchy): blocker matrix must not contradict roadmap section 3/5 status
impact: Row OD-HIST04-A (matrix) lists EVOL-X section 3 as '[ ] FORMAL PROTOCOL 03 B6 - PENDING_AUTHORITY' as an EXACT_BLOCKER. EVOL-X IIAC B6 acceptance and formal closure (1dd76933, be77b3a5, 7a4f279f) are ancestors of the W5 base and the roadmap section 3 cell was reconciled to CLOSED by e46ddcef1 on 2026-11-11, after the W6-G4 settlement. The matrix remains labelled unchanged, so a reader of the settlement sees a blocker that the SSOT no longer lists. Roadmap wins by the authority hierarchy; no certified claim is weakened.
recommendation: Owner adds a dated supersession note to the OD-HIST04-A row (or a new ticket per D-W6-07) stating that EVOL-X formal closure is recorded in roadmap section 5; do not edit the closed settlement silently.
decision_authority: Operator (follow-on predecessor work requires new tickets per D-W6-07)
